verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes up to 228 GB/s of LPDDR5x memory bandwidth and documents an on-device AI toolchain (AI Hub, GenieX unified NPU/GPU/CPU runtime, quantization), so half of the story's stated requirement is met. However, Qualcomm explicitly does not publish a maximum memory capacity, and nothing in the evidence shows a 70B-class quantized model fitting or running at practical speed. Missing for 10: published max addressable memory capacity, evidence that 70B-class quantized models fit and run, hands-on or independent tokens/sec benchmarks for large LLMs.
